summary:
From January to March you wrote mostly about your PhD model, which had been "failing" for six months, and about supervisions with Prof. Hartmann. You described reframing its failures, fixing a normalisation bug, and in March finding "oscillatory bursts" before network collapse in 39 of 47 runs, which then replicated in a second architecture. Hartmann said, "This is interesting." On 26 March you submitted an abstract to the Barcelona conference. Impostor syndrome, perfectionism and Dev, after you "officially ended things" in December, came up throughout, along with Sunita.

In January you filled out a self-referral to UCL counselling, and in March you wrote about starting sessions. Some entries describe the same things differently: the counsellor appears as both Dr. Osei and Dr. Obi, the first session is dated both 14 and 25 March, and early February describes the model as still broken. On 31 March you wrote, "April. I'm ready."
